title: Nelson Museum Archives & Gallery

services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: The Nelson Museum, Archives & Gallery is an art gallery, museum, archives, cold war bunker heritage site, and gift shop - all housed in a beautiful heritage building in downtown Nelson, British Columbia. The building was constructed in 1902 as a facility for the Postal, Customs, and Inland Revenue services. The composite Chateauesque- Richardsonian Romanesque style building excellently combines granite, Kaslo, BC marble, local brick, and pink brick from Spokane, Washington. Areas of the Nelson Museum are available to rent for small private functions, such as weddings, family reunions, and board meetings, as well as for photo shoots, and as a film location.
